fields.statement: At 9560eed9, built with go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza and run by hand in a scratch repo with fake rex and claude on PATH and HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME pointed at scratch dirs: with no machine.toml, rhiza machine show says trust daily (no machine config) naming $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/rhiza/machine.toml; trust = "dedicated" reads as dedicated; with XDG_CONFIG_HOME unset it reads ~/.config/rhiza/machine.toml (daily when absent, dedicated once written); trust = "root" and 'not = [toml' both exit 1 with an error naming the file's path.

At 9560eed9, built with go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza and run by hand in a scratch repo with fake rex and claude on PATH and HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME pointed at scratch dirs: with no file and with trust = "daily", session start --permission-mode bypassPermissions and run start --workflow passes --permission-mode bypassPermissions exit 1 with 'needs a machine with trust = "dedicated" in <path>/machine.toml' and nothing reaches rex or claude. With trust = "dedicated", session start succeeds, session run launches claude with --permission-mode bypassPermissions, and run start runs its agent step to completion with claude launched with bypassPermissions. After switching the file to daily between session start and session run, session run is refused naming the file and claude is not launched. trust = "root" refuses bypass naming the file; acceptEdits still starts with a bad file. Separate finding: with HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME both unset, a file at the relative path '$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/rhiza/machine.toml' in the cwd grants bypass.

At 9560eed9, built with go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza and run by hand in a scratch repo with fake rex and claude on PATH and HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME pointed at scratch dirs: rhiza health --json puts machine between autonomy and disk; with no file it is ok 'trust daily (no machine config)', with trust = "dedicated" ok 'trust dedicated (from <path>)', with a malformed file warn 'could not be read: machine config <path>: ...'. Human rhiza health shows 'ok   machine  trust dedicated (from <path>)'.

At 9560eed9, built with go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza and run by hand in a scratch repo with fake rex and claude on PATH and HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME pointed at scratch dirs: rhiza machine show prints 'trust: daily (no machine config; it would be <path>)' with no file and 'trust: dedicated (from <path>)' with one; a bad file exits 1 naming the file; rhiza machine show --json and rhiza api call machine.show give identical bytes (cmp); describe --json lists machine.show as the only machine operation and none writes trust.
